business_problem: DeepHealth needed to handle rising imaging volumes, a worsening radiologist shortage, and the need to deliver faster, more consistent cancer detection without limiting access to high-quality diagnostics to major urban hospitals.
solution_summary: DeepHealth built DeepHealth OS entirely on Google Cloud to unify clinical AI, enterprise imaging, and imaging operations in a single radiology platform. Cloud Healthcare API streams and stores more than 20 million medical images each year with healthcare-oriented privacy controls and multi-zone replication for availability across regions. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform routes exams to the right specialists based on qualifications and expertise, while Gemini drafts and summarizes radiology reports from dictated findings so physicians can review structured results faster. For domain-specific reasoning, DeepHealth fine-tunes MedGemma for healthcare use cases. BigQuery curates training cohorts and powers performance analytics, and Looker sits on top of the stack to surface dashboards and outcome insights to clinical and operational users.

solution_components.name: Cloud Healthcare API
solution_components.role: Streams and stores imaging data for DeepHealth OS with healthcare-oriented interoperability, privacy, and multi-zone availability.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
solution_components.role: Routes imaging exams to the right radiology specialists and coordinates agentic workflow steps across radiology operations.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Summarizes dictated radiology findings into draft reports that radiologists can quickly review and finalize.

solution_components.name: MedGemma
solution_components.role: Provides medical-grade language-model reasoning that DeepHealth fine-tunes for specialized clinical AI workflows.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Curates model-training cohorts and stores performance analytics used by physicians and technologists.

solution_components.name: Looker
solution_components.role: Delivers organization-wide dashboards so non-technical users can analyze imaging performance and outcomes.

data_flow: Imaging centers stream scans into Cloud Healthcare API, where DeepHealth OS makes them available to radiology workflows. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform routes studies to the right specialists, Gemini and MedGemma assist with report drafting and clinical reasoning, and BigQuery plus Looker expose cohort, quality, and performance analytics across the network.
business_outcome: DeepHealth improved detection and reporting consistency while helping clinicians find cancers earlier, reduce manual reporting work, and scale advanced imaging workflows across a broad provider network.

76% of lung cancers found at earlier stages

DeepHealth uses Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to run agentic tooling across radiology workflows, mainly routing the right exams to the right specialists.
Gemini helps draft or summarize report content that, once finalized, referring physicians can act on.
DeepHealth uses BigQuery to curate data cohorts for AI model training and to provide performance analytics to customers.
Looker sits on top of the stack to deliver organizational dashboards across the network.
